tasks.subject: [marketplace-update-disclosure-binding] [P1] Move DisclosedEffects to the shared wire and make every check disclose
tasks.description: Move the DisclosedEffects types to @dorkos/shared/marketplace-schemas (server disclosed-effects.ts uses them); add InstallationUpdateCheck.disclosed and MarketplacePackageDetail.disclosed; checkInstalledUpdates plans with disclose (spec D1). Tests: GET /updates carries disclosed; an unreadable new version is unknown.

tasks.phaseName: P1 — Bound applies and activation consent
tasks.subject: [marketplace-update-disclosure-binding] [P1] Bind POST /updates to the targets a person was shown; retire the unbound applies
tasks.description: New strict body {apply, projectPath?, targets[{installPath, latestVersion, disclosed}], confirmationToken?}; gate compares recomputed updates to targets (409 disclosure_changed), trusted callers proceed, agents get the ConfirmationProvider card (202/403); delete applyInstalledUpdates and UpdateFlow.run apply; per-package route strict and advisory (spec D2). Exploit tests: agent never applies without a granted card; stale disclosure is 409 with installer untouched; per-package apply is 400.

tasks.phaseName: P1 — Bound applies and activation consent
tasks.subject: [marketplace-update-disclosure-binding] [P1] Gate global activation on consent for what a plugin runs
tasks.description: global-plugin-consent.ts (readActivationEffects via readRunnableDeclarations, runsOnItsOwn, globalActivationEntry, partitionGlobalPlugins); refreshActivatedPlugins activates only consented packages (spec D3). Tests: unapproved hook/MCP plugin withheld, approved loads, edited-on-disk withheld again, runs-nothing loads, unreadable withholds, unreadable config withholds, refused wins over approved; parity test through the real installer.
